zh_TW: 自動攻擊（靠近敵人自己砍）

en: That's all for now. More is on the way.
zh_TW: 目前的內容到這裡，後面還在做

en: That's all for now. Keep exploring, or return to the title from the pause menu.
zh_TW: 目前的內容到這裡。可以繼續逛，或從暫停選單回標題。

en: You fell. Returning to the last checkpoint…
zh_TW: 你倒下了。回到上一個檢查點……
釋放（把身上的毒炸出去）

en: You're at full health, so you won't see any effect. Drink it anyway?
zh_TW: 現在滿血，看不出效果。還是要喝嗎？
防禦歸零 → 受傷減少

en: Blinded → Every cut finds a weak spot
zh_TW: 致盲 → 刀刀砍中要害
疫病 → 全能力提升＋回血

en: These Curses Are Far Too Useful to Me
zh_TW: 這些詛咒對我太有用了

en: My "infection-prone" body turned out to be the cheat that flips everything
zh_TW: 被嫌棄的易感染體質，其實是逆轉一切的外掛

en: Chapter 1: The Tumor and the Junk
zh_TW: 第一章　毒瘤與破爛的共鳴

en: Defeat the poison slimes in the glade
zh_TW: 打倒空地上的劇毒史萊姆

en: Follow the scream to the altar
zh_TW: 往慘叫聲傳來的祭壇走

en: See what happened at the altar
zh_TW: 去祭壇看看出了什麼事

en: Bring down the Abyssal Plague Golem
Find the strange pulse deep in the bog
zh_TW: 尋找毒沼深處的異常波動

en: {interact} Gather / use　{attack} Attack　{dodge} Dodge　{release} Burst the poison on you
zh_TW: {interact} 採集、互動　{attack} 攻擊　{dodge} 閃避　{release} 把身上的毒炸出去

en: {interact} Gather / use　Get close and Norn attacks on his own　{dodge} Dodge　{release} Burst the poison on you
zh_TW: {interact} 採集、互動　靠近敵人會自己砍　{dodge} 閃避　{release} 把身上的毒炸出去
{move} 移動　{sprint} 跑　{look} 轉視角

en: {attack} Attack　{dodge} Dodge　{release} Burst the poison on you
zh_TW: {attack} 攻擊　{dodge} 閃避　{release} 把身上的毒炸出去

en: Get close and Norn attacks on his own　{dodge} Dodge　{release} Burst the poison on you
zh_TW: 靠近敵人會自己砍　{dodge} 閃避　{release} 把身上的毒炸出去

en: Every ailment on you flips into a boon.
zh_TW: 落在你身上的異常狀態，全都會反轉成增益。

en: The Corrupt Forest is open to explore!
Gather 5 glowing toxic mushrooms and look for whatever is wrong deeper in. Traps and poison are your supplies — walk right into them.
zh_TW: 採 5 朵夜光毒蕈，找找森林深處的異常。陷阱和毒物都是你的補給——故意踩進去。

en: A scream echoes from deep in the forest!
It came from the altar to the north.
zh_TW: 聲音是從北邊的祭壇傳來的。

en: That is a poison vent! Go arou— w-why are you standing IN it!?
zh_TW: 那是毒氣噴發口！繞過——你、你怎麼站進去了！？

en: That web is coated in paralytic venom... you did that on purpose, did you not!
zh_TW: 那張網有麻痺毒……你是故意撞上去的對不對！

en: Do not eat that, it is rott— ...never mind. Enjoy.
zh_TW: 那個爛掉了不能吃——……算了，你吃吧。

en: You rest by the fire. Progress saved.
zh_TW: 在營火旁休息了一下。進度已存檔。

en: The smoke vial Sera fires when you ask now carries a paralytic too: every cut finds a weak spot, and you attack faster.
zh_TW: 向席菈要的煙霧彈多調了一份麻痺：刀刀砍中要害，出手也變快。

en: Curse of Weakness → Every cut hits harder
zh_TW: 衰弱詛咒 → 砍得更重

en: You got the Ominous Split Blade. Every cut that lands gives you a stack of bleeding and a stack of weakness: faster and heavier with every hit.
zh_TW: 獲得【不祥的裂刃】：每砍中一刀，給自己一層流血＋一層衰弱——越砍越快、越砍越重。

en: Th-that chest is cursed! ...and you opened it anyway. Of course you did.
zh_TW: 那、那個寶箱有詛咒！……你還是直接開了。我就知道。

en: This one is my Deadly Red... it should be fine. For you.
zh_TW: 這瓶是【劇毒大紅水】……給你的話，應該沒問題！

en: The air over the bog is thick... my mask can take it. Probably.
zh_TW: 沼澤上面的瘴氣好濃……面具應該撐得住。應該。

en: ...C-can we sit for a bit? There is something I want to tell you.
zh_TW: ……可以坐一下嗎？我、我有件事想跟你說。

en: Go ahead. The fire is just right.
I used to be an apprentice at an alchemy workshop in the capital. One day an adventurer came in with a wound nothing could close, so I secretly used a potion I had mixed myself.
zh_TW: 我以前在王都的鍊金工坊當學徒。有一次，一個冒險者的傷怎麼都治不好，我就偷偷用了自己調的藥。

en: The wound closed. And then he was out cold for three whole days. ...They threw me out the next morning. My master said what I make is not medicine. It is a disaster.
zh_TW: 傷是好了。可是他整整昏迷了三天。……隔天我就被趕出來了。師傅說，我做的東西不是藥，是災難。

en: So today, when you took my potion and just... laughed, I honestly did not know what to do.
zh_TW: 所以今天你挨了我的藥還笑得出來，我真的不知道該怎麼辦才好。

en: That was not your fault. You were trying to save him.
zh_TW: 那不是妳的錯。妳是想救他。

en: A disaster? Then brew the biggest one you can and shoot it all at me.
zh_TW: 災難？那就調出最大的災難，全部射給我。

en: ...Mm. Thank you. Nobody has ever told me that.
zh_TW: ……嗯。謝謝你。從來沒有人這樣跟我說過。

en: Eh!? ...O-okay! I will! The biggest one ever!
zh_TW: 咦！？……好、好！我會調的！最大的那種！

en: Um... next time you ask for the smoke vial, I will mix a paralytic into it too. Two at once should be... even better. For you, I mean.
zh_TW: 那個……下次你要煙霧彈的時候，我會多調一份麻痺進去。兩種一起，對你來說應該……更厲害吧？

en: Th-that was a person! Over by the altar...!
zh_TW: 那、那是人的聲音！在祭壇那邊……！

en: W-wait! We have not dealt with the slimes here yet...!
zh_TW: 等、等一下！這邊的史萊姆還沒解決……！

en: S-slimes! H-hang on, I will back you up!
zh_TW: 史、史萊姆！等、等一下，我來幫你——

en: No no no! Norn, I am so sorry, I messed up again!
zh_TW: 完了完了！諾恩，對不起我又搞砸了！

en: Mask, mask... okay, it is on!
The smoke one? O-okay, here it comes!
W-wait, I am still loading the next one!
zh_TW: 等、等一下，還在裝下一瓶！

en: {ask_sera} Ask Sera for a blinding smoke vial
zh_TW: {ask_sera} 向席菈要一瓶致盲煙霧彈

en: {ask_sera} Sera is loading the next vial… {sec}
Paralyzed → Faster attacks　Defense zero → Less damage taken
zh_TW: 麻痺 → 出手加速　防禦歸零 → 受傷減少

en: You attack 150% faster, every cut hits that much harder, and you take 80% less damage. Cut them down!
zh_TW: 出手快 150%、每一刀也重 150%，受到的傷害少 80%。趁現在砍！

en: W-wait, that is miasma! Without a mask, normal people collapse in ten minutes!
zh_TW: 等、等一下，那是瘴氣！沒戴面具進去，普通人十分鐘就會倒下的！

en: Funny. I feel better than I have all week.
zh_TW: 奇怪。我覺得這是我這禮拜精神最好的一次。

en: ...Y-you are glowing gold. Does poison just... not work on you?
zh_TW: ……你、你身上在發金光耶。毒對你……沒有用嗎？

en: Looks like it does more than nothing. Come on. Keep that mask on and stay behind me.
zh_TW: 好像不只是沒用。走吧，妳面具戴好，跟在我後面。

en: U-um! You are the one who took the toxic mushroom request at the guild... right?
zh_TW: 那、那個！你是在公會接下毒蕈委託的人……對吧？

en: That is me. And you are?
I-I am Sera, an apprentice alchemist. ...The one everybody avoids. The side effects of my potions are stronger than the potions.
zh_TW: 我、我叫席菈，見習鍊金術師。……就是大家在躲的那個。我做的藥，副作用都比藥效還強。

en: Um... my potions do have side effects, but in a place full of poison mist, they might actually be useful... Could I come with you?
zh_TW: 那個……雖然我的藥水有副作用，但如果是去毒霧區，說不定能派上用場……能讓我跟你一起去嗎？

en: Sure. Walking alone is boring anyway.
Side effects stronger than the potion? Now I want to try one.
zh_TW: 副作用比藥效還強？我反而想試試看。

en: R-really!? Thank you! I have a gas mask, so I can handle the miasma. I will not slow you down!
zh_TW: 真、真的可以嗎！？謝謝你！我有防毒面具，瘴氣我撐得住，不會拖累你的！

en: Y-you want to try one!? People usually run when they hear that...! I have a gas mask for the miasma, and you can have all the potions you want!
zh_TW: 咦、你想試！？大家聽到都是用跑的耶……！我有防毒面具，瘴氣我撐得住——藥要多少有多少！

en: I-I am so sorry! I grabbed the wrong vial again... Huh? You are... fine?
zh_TW: 對、對不起！我又拿錯瓶了……咦？你……沒事？

en: Fine? That was the best thing anyone has ever shot at me.
zh_TW: 沒事。應該說，那是我這輩子挨過最棒的一發。

en: Norn... you really do not get hurt by what I make?
zh_TW: 諾恩……你真的不會因為我的能力而受傷嗎？

en: Never. To me, your failures are the best medicine there is.
zh_TW: 不會。妳的失敗作，對我來說是最好的藥。

en: It only startles me. Shout before you shoot next time.
zh_TW: 只是會嚇一跳。下次射之前先喊一聲。

en: ...Nobody has ever said that to me. Th-then I will make lots more!
zh_TW: ……第一次有人這樣說。那、那我之後多做一點！

en: O-okay! I will shout! ...So, um, you will still let me shoot you?
zh_TW: 好、好的！我會喊的！……那個，所以你還願意讓我射？

en: Poisons whoever drinks it for 20 seconds.
...You two? The kid with no aptitude, and... the walking gas bomb.
zh_TW: ……是你們？那個沒適性的，跟……移動毒氣彈。

en: Stay back... Step inside the ring around that thing and your whole body gives out. And you just keep bleeding... None of us can even stand.
zh_TW: 別過來……那傢伙身邊那一圈，站進去全身都使不上力，血還一直流……我們三個連站都站不起來。

en: That's... the Abyssal Plague Golem! Its aura halves everyone's abilities and makes them bleed nonstop. Who touched the altar?!
zh_TW: 那是……【深淵疫病魔像】！牠周圍的光環會讓所有人的能力掉一半、不停失血——是誰碰了祭壇的機關？！

en: Abilities cut in half, and constant bleeding...
zh_TW: 能力掉一半，還會一直失血……

en: Stay behind me, Sera. For everyone else that ring is a death trap. For me, it's home turf.
zh_TW: 席菈，跟在我後面。那一圈對別人是死路——對我是主場。

en: ...You won? Just the two of you... the guild's two biggest washouts...
zh_TW: ……贏了？就憑你們兩個……公會的兩大廢物……

en: Norn! A-are you all right? That was the worst failure I've ever brewed. I thought for sure—
zh_TW: 諾恩！你、你沒事吧？剛剛那一瓶是我調過最糟的失敗作，我還以為——

en: It was the strongest thing I've ever been hit with. Without it, that core would never have cracked.
zh_TW: 那是我挨過最猛的一瓶。沒有它，核心砍不碎。

en: ...So my potion... actually helped, for once?
It saved the day. I'm counting on you from now on.
zh_TW: 幫大忙了。以後也拜託你。

en: Half the credit is yours. We split the core.
zh_TW: 一半功勞是你的。核心我們一人一半。

en: ...Yes! L-leave it to me! I'll brew something even worse— I mean, even better!
zh_TW: ……嗯！交、交給我！我會調出更糟的——不是，更厲害的！

en: H-half?! That core is worth a fortune...! ...Thank you, Norn.
zh_TW: 一、一半？！那個核心很貴的……！……謝謝你，諾恩。

en: Let's go. We're taking the golem's core back to the guild. Lilith is in for a shock.
zh_TW: 走吧，把魔像的核心帶回公會。莉莉絲看到大概會嚇一跳。

en: Plague aura: all abilities down 50% and constant bleeding
zh_TW: 疫病光環：全能力下降 50%＋持續失血

en: On Norn it flips: all abilities up 50% and fast healing
zh_TW: 落在諾恩身上反轉：全能力提升 50%＋高速回血

en: He... walked right into the aura?!
My mask's filter won't hold long in here... Be careful, Norn!
zh_TW: 面具的濾芯在這裡撐不了多久……諾恩，小心！

en: Sera is falling back to load her forbidden brew. Hold on.
zh_TW: 席菈退到後面裝她的禁藥——撐住。

en: I-I still have one... a forbidden one! Give me a moment to load it!
zh_TW: 我、我還有一瓶……禁藥！給我一點時間裝！

en: Shield Sera: stand on the beam of light on the ground
zh_TW: 擋在席菈前面——站到地上那道光上

en: Shield Sera: stand on the beam between her and the golem
zh_TW: 擋在席菈前面：站到她和魔像之間那道光上

en: You shielded Sera. The golem is spent!
zh_TW: 你擋住了，席菈沒事——魔像力竭了！

en: At the next gaze, stand between her and the golem
zh_TW: 下一次凝視，擋在她和魔像中間

en: I-I can move again... Loading it one more time!
zh_TW: 能、能動了……我重新裝一次！

en: Loaded! Norn, take all of it!
Chaos Catastrophe Brew: every curse she can make, all at once
zh_TW: 【混沌大災難藥劑】：她做得出來的壞東西一次全部上身

en: All of it flips. Shatter the golem's core!
zh_TW: 全部反轉——砍碎魔像的核心！

en: It won't break... The core is still holding it together!
